description:
Simulates multi-day prop-firm evaluation pass and breach rates across up to 500 paths.

Computes daily/overall drawdown breach rates, consistency-rule lock frequency, and
optimal risk-per-trade on your trade R-multiples or win/loss parameters. Pro tool
(1 credit on hosted, 0 locally).

avg_loss_r.description: Average losing trade R-multiple magnitude when trades_r is omitted.
avg_loss_r.title: Avg Loss R

avg_win_r.description: Average winning trade R-multiple when trades_r is omitted.
avg_win_r.title: Avg Win R

challenge_fee_usd.description: Prop evaluation fee in USD used to compute expected net value.
challenge_fee_usd.title: Challenge Fee Usd

consistency_cap_pct.description: Max single-day profit share allowed by consistency rules (e.g. 0.40 for 40%).
consistency_cap_pct.title: Consistency Cap Pct

max_loss_limit_pct.description: Overall max drawdown limit fraction (e.g. 0.10 for 10%).
max_loss_limit_pct.title: Max Loss Limit Pct

n_paths.description: Number of Monte Carlo evaluation paths to simulate (1-500).
n_paths.title: N Paths

payout_split_pct.description: Trader profit split fraction upon passing (e.g. 0.80 for 80%).
payout_split_pct.title: Payout Split Pct

risk_pct_per_trade.description: Fraction of equity risked per trade (e.g. 0.0075 for 0.75%).
risk_pct_per_trade.title: Risk Pct Per Trade

trades_per_day.description: Average number of trades executed per trading session.
trades_per_day.title: Trades Per Day

trades_r.description: Optional list of historical trade R-multiples (min 5) to bootstrap from; omit to use parametric win_rate/avg_win_r/avg_loss_r.
trades_r.title: Trades R

win_rate.description: Win probability in [0.01, 0.99] when trades_r is omitted.
win_rate.title: Win Rate

name: gym.prop_challenge_sim
title: Prop-Challenge Monte Carlo Pass & Breach Simulator
